_meta.purpose: Locked parameter database for the dynamical emergence engine. Every entry is an INDEPENDENTLY measured/published value or a UNIVERSAL law or a documented modelling choice -- NEVER a value chosen by us to match an organ mass or a developmental stage. The engine reads ONLY this DB for physical parameters; it never reads the validation targets when selecting them. This is the difference between a LOCKED measured input [L] and a back-fit.

grades.[L]: locked: independently measured/published value or universal law, cited; legitimate to use
grades.[F]: fixed modelling choice (functional form / generic central value of a cited range); documented
grades.[O]: open: the entity-specific measured value does not exist in literature accessible here; a generic [F] placeholder stands in and the residual is declared open

_meta.rule: UNIVERSAL or CITED-MEASURED => not a violation. PER-TARGET-TUNED => forbidden. No entry below was tuned to a target.
_meta.non_fit_invariant: verify_emergence.py asserts the engine produces identical parameters whether or not the target tables are present (params are target-independent).

kinetics._axis: WHEN (developmental timing) -- general mammalian transcription/translation timescales, measured independently of any cardiac stage

pol2_elongation_kb_per_min.provenance: RNA Pol II in-vivo elongation ~1.5-4.3 kb/min: Darzacq et al. 2007 (Nat Struct Mol Biol); Singh & Padgett 2009 (Nat Struct Mol Biol ~3.8 kb/min). Central value of the cited range.

mrna_halflife_h.provenance: Median mammalian mRNA half-life ~9 h: Schwanhausser et al. 2011, 'Global quantification of mammalian gene expression control', Nature 473:337. Measured genome-wide, target-independent.

protein_halflife_h.provenance: Median mammalian protein half-life ~46 h: Schwanhausser et al. 2011, Nature 473:337. Genome-wide, target-independent.

translation_aa_per_s.provenance: Mammalian ribosome elongation ~2-6 aa/s: Ingolia et al. 2011; Schwanhausser 2011. Central value.

relay_threshold_theta.provenance: Activation threshold (fraction of steady state) at which a regulator is counted ON. Modelling choice; engine is required to be theta-robust over [0.3,0.7] (asserted in gate).

allometry._axis: HOW BIG (size) -- universal scaling laws + general mammalian organ-scaling exponents, measured independently of human organ masses

kleiber_metabolic_exponent.provenance: Basal metabolic rate ~ M^(3/4): Kleiber 1932 ('Body size and metabolism', Hilgardia). A universal interspecific law.

growth_supply_exponent_alpha.provenance: Dosage(size supply) ~ (developmental time available)^alpha, single UNIVERSAL exponent applied to ALL organs identically (not per-organ). alpha=1 is the documented modelling choice; not tuned to any mass.

organ_scaling_exponent_reference._grade: [L] reference table (NOT used to fit; available grounded inputs)
organ_scaling_exponent_reference._provenance: General mammalian organ-mass vs body-mass scaling exponents, compiled from comparative physiology (Stahl 1965 Science 'Organ weights in primates and other mammals'; Prothero 'The Design of Mammals'). These are external measured general relationships; if used, they enter as [L] grounded inputs, never as tuned coefficients.

diffusion_um2_per_s.provenance: Typical morphogen effective diffusion ~0.1-10 um^2/s (e.g. Bicoid, FGF, Nodal): Kicheva et al. 2007 (Science); Yu et al. 2009. Central value; target-independent.

morphogen_decay_min.provenance: Morphogen clearance timescale ~tens of minutes-hours: Kicheva et al. 2007. Generic central value.

_open._axis: [O] data-blocked specifics (NOT in this DB; declared open, generic placeholders used)
_open.per_gene_transcription_rate: [O] exact per-cardiac-gene kinetic constants -> generic mammalian medians stand in
_open.tissue_mechanical_properties: [O] cardiac tissue stiffness/viscosity time-course -> not modelled at continuum fidelity
_open.organ_growth_rate_atlas: [O] measured per-organ developmental growth-rate trajectories -> universal supply rule stands in
